verdict: Moody's profit rose 14% to $734M on revenue up just 1% — a $115M gain from selling businesses and a lower tax rate did most of the lifting.

segments.name: Credit ratings (MIS)
segments.note: Fees for rating bonds and loans — companies and governments pay Moody's to judge their creditworthiness.

segments.name: Moody's Analytics
segments.note: Data, software and research subscriptions that help banks, insurers and companies measure risk.

segments.name: Corporate & eliminations
segments.note: Corporate items and eliminations between the two businesses — a small negative that brings the segments to total revenue.

opex.name: Depreciation and amortization
opex.note: Wearing-out cost of buildings, systems and acquired intangibles.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Costs of reorganizing parts of the business.

otherDetail: A $115M gain on business divestitures and $1M of other income, less $54M of net interest expense and $2M of profit attributable to noncontrolling interests.
oneTimers: A $115M pre-tax gain on business divestitures sits in non-operating income. Excluding it and related items, adjusted EPS was $4.14, up 6% — a cleaner read on the quarter than the 18% GAAP jump.

takeaways.title: Growth was modest at the core
takeaways.text: Ratings revenue rose 3% to $939M while Moody's Analytics slipped 1% to $1,138M — total revenue grew just 1% to $2.0B.

takeaways.title: A one-off gain flatters profit
takeaways.text: Selling businesses added a $115M pre-tax gain below the operating line. It is the main reason GAAP EPS rose 18% while adjusted EPS rose 6%.

takeaways.title: A friendlier tax rate helped
takeaways.text: The effective tax rate fell to 24.0% from 25.4%, helped by the lapse of a statute of limitations on an old acquisition-related tax exposure.

footerNote: Moody's does not report a cost-of-revenue line. Here, its $524M of 'operating' expenses — the analysts and data specialists who produce the ratings and analytics — are treated as the direct cost of revenue. Net income of $734M is attributable to Moody's; consolidated net income was $736M.
